title: Victorian privacy regulator finds Education Department breached privacy law after school-system breach
what_changed: The event was dated 20 November 2026 from IDM's article, but OVIC's investigation report is dated October 2026 and iTnews reported it on 7 October 2026. Re-recorded as victoria-education-ovic-student-breach-report-2026-10 (dated 2026-10-07, OVIC report read and cited first); the November record is marked duplicate_of it because a worker could not move the file to the October folder. The department 'welcomes and accepts' OVIC's recommendations (Appendix A); the stolen details covered every current government school student and hundreds of thousands of former students.
